etymologies.etymologyHTML: Back-formation from diagnosis. Compare also sclerose (verb).

definitions.definition: (transitive, medicine) To determine which disease is causing a sick person's signs and symptoms; to find the diagnosis.
(by extension) To determine the cause of a problem.

quote.citation: 1962 October, M. J. Wilson, “Three years of dieselisation at Devons Road depot”, in Modern Railways, pages 262, 264:
quote.text: But in the early days of the scheme the new machines created some problems for the fitters, who found them over-complex and their faults hard to diagnose after many years' experience of small, simple steam locomotives.

quote.citation: 2002, John J. Schiavone, Training for On-board Bus Electronics, page 19:
quote.text: Mechanics use this extremely portable tool to diagnose engine faults, clear fault codes, and export data.
